# Snipe 1.1.0
## ✨ What's new
- Edit metadata - hold Option in the Finder menu, choose Edit Meta to change title, artist, and more for video, audio, and images. Only shows fields you can actually change. - Conversions keep metadata by default - names, dates, and locations carry over. Turn it off in the converter or under Settings → Quick Menu → Defaults. - Finder conversions use your settings - pick quality, size, sound, and more once in Settings → Quick Menu → Defaults, and every quick conversion from Finder follows them. - A menu that matches Finder - cleaner to read, with Regular or Clear style on the latest macOS. Clearer tick when you point at a choice, with separate sound and vibration switches in Settings. - Edit several files side by side - each file opens its own window. Instant actions like Mute or Clean Meta won't close what you're editing.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Clicking the menu no longer changes your Finder selection. - No more faint box around the menu on dark backgrounds.

# Snipe 1.0.1
## 🐞 Bug Fixes
- Fixes minor bugs.

# Snipe 1.0
First release.
## ✨ What's new
- Convert files without leaving Finder. Select files, double-tap Shift, pick a format from the ring - 2,500+ conversions across images, video, audio, and documents, including HEIC, WebM, EPUB, and Office files - Hold Option with the ring open for edit tools: trim, compress, crop, rotate, clean metadata, and more - Converter tab for batch jobs, with quality, size, and bitrate controls plus presets - Install guides for ffmpeg, pandoc, and LibreOffice to unlock the remaining formats - Everything runs on your Mac, files never upload anywhere - Hover sounds on the ring, can be turned off in Menu settings - Interactive first-run tour that walks through the first conversion - 3-day free trial, then one payment for 3 Macs
